monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral harvest and trimming scissors decision system covering four distinct cutting jobs, measured hand fit, component evidence, exact cleaning compatibility, a return-window test, maintenance, recalls, retirement, and whole-system cost. It adds no merchant, product, price, coupon, ranking, stock claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement and preserves a valid no-purchase outcome.

image_qa.note: The fertility guide, trimming-scissors guide, and deployed discovery policy use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No clinical, cannabis product, trimming-tool, merchant, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue was introduced.

search_console.decision: The September 28–October 25 report showed 841 impressions, four clicks, 0.476% CTR, and average position 22.477. It is six days old and usable, but no unaddressed editorial query or page had meaningful volume in the roughly position-4-to-20 band, so no item is primarily Data-led. The Guides hub and Stem Cell CBG had already been reinforced; About, Contact, Affiliate Disclosure, and Editorial Policy are navigational; Montana has two impressions; the HTTP, pre-roll, and federal-property rows have one impression; and Blue Dream sits mostly around positions 40–61. The stale sitemap rows also showed retired WordPress submissions last downloaded in 2023 or submitted in 2025. The report prevented another overlapping CBG, hub, Montana, pre-roll, federal-property, or Blue Dream page and prompted a live canonical-sitemap response gate while the editorial work expanded distinct fertility and hand-tool areas.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy fertility evidence map and preconception handoff record grounded in current ASRM, ACOG, and CDC sources. The endpoint matrix, study-reader, exact exposure record, clinical-visit path, countdown boundary, and commercial-claim screen strengthen the pregnancy and clinician-preparation cluster through reciprocal contextual links, with a scoped onward path to medication-interaction guidance. No speculative outreach target was added and no outreach was sent.
